hypothesis: Using only separate FIT actual executed probe/ final-action reward logs, a classical latent-mixture heldout-likelihood selector can infer whether cue and diagnostic noise follow Gaussian or Laplace families, then earn useful net diagnostic value on unfamiliar worlds and outperform fixed-family baselines in a mixed-family world.

source.type: fresh author-generated synthetic DEV only; never use source hidden state in learning
source.physical_world: latent effect theta fair +/-1; observed cue theta*visible_cue_gain+visible_cue_sigma*noise_c; optional paid diagnostic theta*visible_probe_gain+visible_probe_sigma*noise_p; executed reward theta*executed_final_action+visible_reward_sigma*noise_r-visible_cost*executed_probe; only executed diagnostics measured; never unchosen consequences
source.logged_fit: actually executed Bernoulli(.5) paid probe and independent fair signed final action, log only cue/visible parameters/probe flag/executed diagnostic measurement or zero if skipped/executed action/observed net reward; same fitting log for all methods

model.fit: Use unchanged P54.fit_moments on FIRST 16,384 physically logged episodes, learn prior, cue/probe signal gain and noise variances; reward proxy z=(observed net reward+actual paid cost)/executed final action remains NOISY. Reward proxy noise variance estimated as max(0.05, Var(z)-1).
model.selection: On LAST disjoint 4,096 FIT episodes, compare Gaussian vs Laplace marginal log-likelihood for reward-derived noisy z under latent sign +/-1, then conditional mixture log-likelihood of cue and executed probe measurement with z integrated over both latent theta alternatives; select independently reward, cue and probe family. No actual hidden theta label, no OOD outcome, no test-time adjustment.
model.candidate: Use estimated cue family likelihood for prior log odds and selected diagnostic family for exact Gaussian or Laplace physical value of information; pay only if expected gain > visible cost, update only from actually executed measurement; final signed action and net noisy physical reward.
model.comparators: Exact same fitted P54 parameters with fixed Gaussian/Gaussian, fixed Laplace/Laplace (P55), the fitted never-probe with selected cue model, fitted always-probe, model-aware correct per-channel oracle (privileged), and shuffled factual reward-credit negative.
model.cold: roundtrip selected model JSON sufficient statistics and deterministic observations, require bit-identical executed actions and reward in evaluation
model.strong_controls: report fixed-family, same fitting log, paired per-world reward delta, probe counts, model log-likelihood margins, incorrect/no-info sham outcomes

each_OOD_require: model-aware distribution oracle minus selected reward <=.03
paired bootstrap 95% lower bound selected vs never >0, 1000 resamples fixed seed = 860901+OOD_seed
metrics.mixed_additional: selected learned-family net reward >= max(fixed Gaussian, fixed Laplace)+0.003 on the mixed heldout, not merely selecting the correct family
negative: on sham with zero diagnostic gain, zero actual probes
wrong-shuffled-reward-credit model fails positive reward/probe gain by >=.025 on all OOD
metrics.no_claim_of_independent_scientific_PASS: Authored synthetic and Gaussian/Laplace family choices supplied in advance, not external unknown physics; full Windows and Ubuntu regression plus fully trained neural controls still needed.
